site_url_help: Base URL for generating share links in seed files (e.g. https://your-domain.com). Leave empty to use relative paths.
default_matrix_help: Default hash algorithms to calculate when generating seeds via right-click menu. Upload always calculates all available hashes.
format_policies_help: Enable seed formats globally. Individual storage can override these settings.
auto_generate_help: Automatically generate seed files when uploading (can be overridden per storage)
single_direct_preview_help: When opening a seed containing only one file, directly preview the file instead of showing seed details
cas_direct_access_help: When opening a CAS seed, automatically rapid-upload and preview the file
